# DomAccessCanvasTransfer.spec leaves the real DomAccess to the next spec in its worker

## Context

Found while running the full unit suite for #20045 (PR #20053). `GalleryInternalId.spec` failed one test in 2 of 3 local full runs at that head, with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'getElementById')`.

- **Where it throws:** `DomAccess.getElement` (`src/main/DomAccess.mjs`), reached through `Gallery.afterSetMounted` → `Component.focus` → `DomAccess.focus`.
- **Alone it passes:** 15/15 over five repeats.
- **`dev` was green in 3 of 3 full runs** (one run had an unrelated red). The suite is `fullyParallel`, so the rate depends on which specs land in one worker.

Deterministic repro on `dev` `e2f77dd0fb`, with no local changes:

```bash
npx playwright test -c test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs unit/main/DomAccessCanvasTransfer.spec.mjs unit/selection/GalleryInternalId.spec.mjs --workers=1
```

That gives 1 failed and 6 passed. Pairing `GalleryInternalId.spec` the same way with each of the other six specs that import the real `DomAccess` passes: `DomAccessAlign`, `DragDrop`, `GoogleMapsReadiness`, `GridRowScrollPinning`, `DeltaUpdatesChangeNodeName` and `DomEvents`.

## The Problem

This is `#18776`'s class again. A unit spec replaces `Neo.main.DomAccess` and never restores it. A later spec in the same worker then focuses into the real main-thread singleton over a `document` it does not have.

CI runs the unit tier `fullyParallel` with 4 workers, so this can red any PR's unit job, depending on scheduling.

## The Architectural Reality

- `test/playwright/unit/main/DomAccessCanvasTransfer.spec.mjs` (added by #19589) does three things:
  - it deletes the setup stub when it is not the real class (`Neo.main.DomAccess.className !== 'Neo.main.DomAccess'`);
  - it imports `src/main/DomAccess.mjs`, whose singleton registers itself as `Neo.main.DomAccess`;
  - its `afterEach` restores `document`, `manager.startWorker`, `manager.sendMessage` and `Neo.config.useDomIds`, but not the namespace entry.
- `test/playwright/setup.mjs` installs the stub with `??=`. Whatever a spec leaves under `Neo.main` is what every later spec in that worker gets.
- #18776 fixed the same shape in `DomEvents.spec.mjs`: it captures `replacedRemotes` before the delete and restores them in `afterAll`.

## The Fix

In `DomAccessCanvasTransfer.spec.mjs`:
- capture `Neo.main.DomAccess` before the delete;
- restore it in an `afterAll`, or delete it when it was undefined.

This is the `DomEvents.spec.mjs` pattern.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: the paired run above passes, and removing the restore makes it fail again with the same `getElementById` error.
- [ ] AC-2: `DomAccessCanvasTransfer.spec`'s own arms stay green.

## Out of Scope

A suite-level guard that fails any spec leaving a `Neo.main` remote behind. It's worth it if a third instance appears.
